word_translation_en: to sink; to fall; to decrease
sentence_example: Die Preise sinken in diesem Monat leicht.
sentence_example_translation_en: Prices are falling slightly this month.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Цены немного снижаются в этом месяце.
sentence_synonym: Die Preise fallen in diesem Monat leicht.
typical_collocations: die Preise sinken; das Schiff sinkt; die Temperatur sinkt; zu Boden sinken
usage_comments_en: sinken is an intransitive verb conjugated with sein. It means to move downwards, either physically (e.g., a ship sinking, temperature dropping) or abstractly (prices, levels decreasing). It contrasts with the transitive verb senken (with haben), which means to lower something.

word_translation_en: to sink below the surface; to go under
word_translation_ru: погружаться под воду; идти ко дну
sentence_example: Der Rettungsring verhinderte, dass die Person untersank.
sentence_example_translation_en: The lifebuoy prevented the person from going under.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Спасательный круг не позволил человеку уйти под воду.
sentence_synonym: Der Rettungsring verhinderte, dass die Person unterging.
typical_collocations: im Wasser untersinken; vor dem Ertrinken untersinken
usage_comments_en: untersinken is a rare, formal intransitive verb (conjugated with sein) meaning to sink beneath the surface of a liquid. It is mostly used in literary or highly specific contexts.

word_translation_en: to drop; to sink; to decline
sentence_example: Das Niveau der Sendung ist stark abgesunken.
sentence_example_translation_en: The quality of the show has dropped significantly.
sentence_synonym: Das Niveau der Sendung ist stark abgefallen.
typical_collocations: das Niveau sinkt ab; die Temperatur sinkt ab; auf ein Minimum absinken
usage_comments_en: absinken (intransitive, conjugated with sein) emphasizes a downward trend, often indicating a decline in quality, standard, or level. It is frequently used for abstract levels or values.

word_translation_en: to sink in; to subside; to cave in
sentence_example: Wir sinken tief in den frisch gefallenen Schnee ein.
sentence_example_translation_en: We are sinking deep into the freshly fallen snow.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы глубоко увязаем в свежевыпавшем снегу.
sentence_synonym: Wir versinken tief im frisch gefallenen Schnee.
typical_collocations: im Schlamm einsinken; tief in den Schnee einsinken; im Sofa einsinken
usage_comments_en: einsinken (intransitive, conjugated with sein) means to sink into a soft substance (like mud, snow, or cushions) due to gravity or pressure. It takes the preposition in followed by the dative (location) or accusative (direction).

word_translation_en: to sink down; to collapse; to fall to the ground
sentence_example: Vor Erschöpfung ließ er sich auf die Knie niedersinken.
sentence_example_translation_en: Out of exhaustion, he let himself sink to his knees.
sentence_example_translation_ru: От изнеможения он опустился на колени.
sentence_synonym: Vor Erschöpfung ließ er sich auf die Knie sinken.
typical_collocations: auf die Knie niedersinken; zu Boden niedersinken; entkräftet niedersinken
usage_comments_en: niedersinken (intransitive, conjugated with sein) is a poetic or elevated literary term. It describes a slow, often powerless or deliberate downward motion of a person (e.g., falling to their knees, collapsing gently).

word_translation_en: to fall down; to collapse (from weakness)
word_translation_ru: валиться с ног; падать (от слабости, лишаясь чувств)
sentence_example: Der Soldat sank schwer getroffen um.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Солдат тяжело раненный повалился на землю.
sentence_synonym: Der Soldat fiel schwer getroffen um.
typical_collocations: tot umsinken; ohnmächtig umsinken; vor Schwäche umsinken
usage_comments_en: umsinken is a highly literary and dramatic intransitive verb (conjugated with sein). It implies falling over or collapsing, typically due to injury, exhaustion, or death.

word_translation_en: to sink; to submerge; to be lost (in thoughts)
word_translation_ru: тонуть; погружаться; уходить с головой (в мысли)
sentence_example: Das Schiff versank langsam im tiefen Meer.
sentence_example_translation_en: The ship slowly sank into the deep sea.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Корабль медленно погружался в глубокое море.
sentence_synonym: Das Schiff ging langsam im tiefen Meer unter.
typical_collocations: im Meer versinken; in Gedanken versinken; im Erdboden versinken; in Schweigen versinken
usage_comments_en: versinken (intransitive, conjugated with sein) refers to complete submersion physically (like Atlantis or a ship) or metaphorically (sinking into deep thoughts, silence, or chaos). It is more dramatic than sinken.

word_translation_en: to sink away; to drift off (into sleep/unconsciousness)
sentence_example: Er spürte, wie er langsam in den Schlaf wegsank.
sentence_example_translation_en: He felt himself slowly drifting off into sleep.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он чувствовал, как медленно погружается в сон.
sentence_synonym: Er spürte, wie er langsam in den Schlaf wegdämmerte.
typical_collocations: in den Schlaf wegsinken; in Ohnmacht wegsinken
usage_comments_en: wegsinken (intransitive, conjugated with sein) usually describes a gradual loss of consciousness, transitioning into sleep, anesthesia, or a coma. It is a literary and evocative verb.

word_translation_en: to sink back; to fall back (into cushions/old habits)
word_translation_ru: откинуться назад; снова впадать (в прежнее состояние)
sentence_example: Sie sank erschöpft in die Kissen zurück.
sentence_example_translation_en: She sank back into the pillows, exhausted.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она изнуренно откинулась обратно на подушки.
sentence_synonym: Sie fiel erschöpft in die Kissen zurück.
typical_collocations: in die Kissen zurücksinken; auf den Stuhl zurücksinken; in alte Muster zurücksinken
usage_comments_en: zurücksinken (intransitive, conjugated with sein) is used when someone falls back onto a seat or pillow, or metaphorically when someone relapses into previous states (like behavior patterns or apathy).

word_translation_en: to collapse; to slump down; to shrink
sentence_example: Der Verletzte sank kraftlos in sich zusammen.
typical_collocations: in sich zusammensinken; weinend zusammensinken; vor Schmerz zusammensinken
usage_comments_en: zusammensinken (intransitive, conjugated with sein) refers to a physical posture collapsing inwardly (e.g., slumping in a chair out of grief, shock, or weakness) or structures falling apart. Often used as in sich zusammensinken.
